title: Asset classes, the depreciation run schedule and tax books
summary: Set the depreciation run schedule and convention, and manage asset classes.

steps.text: On {title}, set the run schedule and convention, and add or archive asset classes.

Each asset class offers more actions: apply the class's current depreciation settings to the assets that still follow older ones, fix a posting account by moving existing balances or for future postings only, and revalue every asset of a class that uses the revaluation model.
You can also ask the assistant to change the run schedule or the convention, or to add or edit an asset class. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
